title: Wanted
summary: Three wanted posters for a penguin who keeps escaping, each one designed with less information than the last.
subject: Typography III
coverAlt: Three wanted posters for a penguin, from detailed to almost empty

blocks.heading: The brief
blocks.body: Design a series of three posters that changes one variable from poster to poster.

blocks.heading: The idea
blocks.body: Every time Feathers McGraw escapes, the police know less about him. The posters lose information the same way. The first is full of detail, and the third is a silhouette and a single word.

blocks.label: Research. Old wanted posters and police notices from local archives.

blocks.caption: The series, from the most information to the least.
Letterpress detail of the word Wanted in wood type.

blocks.heading: Reflection
blocks.body: The third poster turned out the strongest, which surprised me. Next time I would start from the emptiest version and add only what is needed.
